_what: Recently Deleted and Archived as DATA, read by read-data/keep-for.mjs. Each state: its id; label (what the person calls it); after_days (how many days it keeps things by default; null keeps until put back; the person's own keep-for replaces it); when_due (what it becomes when that time ends: another state's id, or null: gone for good); due_words (the same in words). keep_for_choices are the usual numbers of days offered (null: until put back). A new state is one row here.
